# zoom

## ZOOM_ADD_A_MEETING_REGISTRANT
Registers a participant for a Zoom meeting that has registration enabled. **Prerequisites:** - The meeting host must have a **licensed (paid) Zoom account** - this will NOT work with free/basic accounts - The meeting must have registration enabled (approval_type = 0 for automatic or 1 for manual approval) - Maximum of 4,999 registrants per meeting **Required fields:** meetingId, first_name, last_name, email **Optional fields:** address, city, state, zip, country, phone, comments, industry, job_title, org, language, auto_approve **Common errors:** - "Only available for paid users" - The meeting host needs a licensed Zoom account - "Registration has not been enabled" - Enable registration via update_a_meeting with approval_type = 0 or 1 - "Meeting not found" - Invalid meeting ID or meeting has ended

## ZOOM_ADD_A_WEBINAR_REGISTRANT
Registers a participant for a Zoom webinar that has registration enabled. **Prerequisites:** - The webinar host must have a **Pro or higher plan with Webinar add-on** - this will NOT work with basic/free accounts - The webinar must have registration enabled (approval_type = 0 for automatic or 1 for manual approval) - Registration type must be properly configured (1=once for all, 2=each occurrence, 3=choose occurrences) **Required fields:** webinarId, first_name, email **Optional fields:** last_name, address, city, state, zip, country, phone, comments, industry, job_title, org, language, occurrence_ids, source_id **Common errors:** - "Webinar plan is missing" - The host needs a Zoom webinar license/add-on - "Registration has not been enabled" - Enable registration via webinar settings with approval_type = 0 or 1 - "Webinar not found" (404) - Invalid webinar ID or webinar has ended - "Host cannot register" - The webinar host cannot register themselves as an attendee

## ZOOM_ADD_PROJECT_COLLABORATORS
Adds one or more collaborators to a whiteboard project. Use this action when you want to invite team members or external users to collaborate on a specific whiteboard project. Project owners or authorized users can add collaborators with different permission levels (owner, editor, or viewer). **Prerequisites:** - The user must be the project owner or have admin permissions - The target user must have a Zoom account - The whiteboard project must exist and be accessible **Required fields:** project_id, collaborators (list with at least one user) **Optional fields:** skip_notifications, invite_message **Common errors:** - "Whiteboard plan is missing" - Whiteboard add-on is required - "User not found" - The collaborator's email is not associated with a Zoom account - "Project not found" - Invalid project ID - "Invalid collaborator role" - Role value must be 1, 2, or 3

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddProjectCollaboratorsRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_id",
    "collaborators"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "project_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard project.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Project ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the whiteboard project you want to add collaborators to. You can find this in the project URL or project details."
    },
    "collaborators": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Collaborator",
        "required": [
          "email"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Role",
            "default": 2,
            "description": "The role to assign to the collaborator: 1 = Owner, 2 = Editor, 3 = Viewer. Defaults to Editor if not specified.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator Role",
            "human_parameter_description": "The permission level for this collaborator: Owner (1), Editor (2), or Viewer (3). Defaults to Editor."
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "description": "The email address of the user to add as a collaborator.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator Email",
            "human_parameter_description": "The email address of the person you want to invite as a collaborator."
          }
        },
        "description": "A user to add as a collaborator on the whiteboard project."
      },
      "title": "Collaborators",
      "description": "List of users to add as collaborators with their email addresses and roles.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Collaborators",
      "human_parameter_description": "A list of people to add as collaborators, each with their email address and permission level."
    },
    "invite_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invite Message",
      "description": "A custom message to include with the project invitation. Maximum 280 characters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Invite Message",
      "human_parameter_description": "An optional personal message to include in the collaborator invitation email. Keep it under 280 characters."
    },
    "skip_notifications": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skip Notifications",
      "description": "If set to true, collaborators will not receive email notifications about the invitation.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Skip Notifications",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to silently add collaborators without sending them email invitations."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddProjectCollaborators`"
}
```

## ZOOM_ADD_WHITEBOARD_COLLABORATOR
Adds one or more collaborators to a whiteboard. Use this action when you need to invite users or team chat channels to collaborate on a specific whiteboard. Supports individual user invites (via email) and team chat channel invites (via channel_id). Collaborators are assigned a role that determines their permission level. On success, returns the list of collaborators that were added. Use this action when you want to share a whiteboard to new users or team chat channels and assign them specific permission levels (owner, co-owner, editor, commenter, or viewer).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddWhiteboardCollaboratorRequest",
  "required": [
    "whiteboardId",
    "collaborators"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "whiteboardId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Whiteboard Id",
      "examples": [
        "1OT3G20JT_uV8XhMunZ5Fg"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Whiteboard ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the unique ID of the whiteboard to which you want to add collaborators. This ID can be found in the whiteboard details."
    },
    "collaborators": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Collaborator",
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "enum": [
              "owner",
              "co_owner",
              "editor",
              "commenter",
              "viewer"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Role",
            "default": "editor",
            "examples": [
              2
            ],
            "description": "The role to assign to the collaborator: 0=Owner, 1=Co-owner, 2=Editor (default), 3=Commenter, 4=Viewer.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator Role",
            "human_parameter_description": "The permission level for this collaborator: Owner (0), Co-owner (1), Editor (2, default), Commenter (3), or Viewer (4)."
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "examples": [
              "user@example.com"
            ],
            "description": "The email address of the user to add as a collaborator. Required for individual users. Cannot be set simultaneously with channel_id.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator Email",
            "human_parameter_description": "The email address of the person you want to add as a collaborator. Leave empty if inviting a channel instead."
          },
          "channel_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Channel Id",
            "examples": [
              "ch123456789"
            ],
            "description": "The team chat channel ID to add as a collaborator. Required for channels. Cannot be set simultaneously with email.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Channel ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The team chat channel ID to invite. Leave empty if inviting individual users instead."
          }
        },
        "description": "A user or channel to add as a collaborator on the whiteboard."
      },
      "title": "Collaborators",
      "description": "List of users or channels to add as collaborators. Supports 1-100 collaborators per request. Each item must have either email (for individual users) or channel_id (for team chat channels), but not both.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Collaborators",
      "human_parameter_description": "A list of people or channels to add as collaborators, each with their email or channel ID and a permission role."
    },
    "invite_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invite Message",
      "examples": [
        "I'm glad to invite you to collaborate on this whiteboard."
      ],
      "description": "A custom message to include with the collaborator invitation. Maximum 280 characters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Invite Message",
      "human_parameter_description": "An optional personal message to include in the collaborator invitation email. Keep it under 280 characters."
    },
    "skip_notifications": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skip Notifications",
      "description": "If true, collaborators will not receive email or in-app notifications about the invitation. Defaults to false (notifications are sent).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Skip Notifications",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to silently add collaborators without sending them email or in-app notifications."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddWhiteboardCollaborator`"
}
```

## ZOOM_APPLY_CLASSIFICATION_TO_WHITEBOARD
Applies or updates a classification label on a whiteboard. Use this action when you need to assign or change a security classification label on an existing whiteboard. Each whiteboard can only have one classification label at a time — if the whiteboard already has a label, it will be replaced with the new one. Rate limit: Light. Required scopes: whiteboard:write:admin, whiteboard:write, whiteboard:update:whiteboard_classification, or whiteboard:update:whiteboard_classification:admin.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ApplyClassificationToWhiteboardRequest",
  "required": [
    "whiteboardId",
    "classification_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "whiteboardId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Whiteboard Id",
      "examples": [
        "1OT3G20JT_uV8XhMunZ5Fg"
      ],
      "description": "The whiteboard's unique identifier."
    },
    "classification_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Classification Id",
      "examples": [
        "test_classification_id"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the classification label to apply to the whiteboard."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ApplyClassificationToWhiteboard`"
}
```

## ZOOM_CREATE_A_MEETING
Enable Zoom meeting creation via user-level apps with "me". "Start_url" for hosts expires in 2 hours, or 90 days for "custCreate" users. Renew via API, capped at 100 requests/day. Requires "meeting:write" permission, subject to medium rate limit.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAMeetingRequest",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": 2,
      "description": "The type of meeting. * `1` - An instant meeting.  * `2` - A scheduled meeting.  * `3` - A recurring meeting with no fixed time.  * `8` - A recurring meeting with fixed time. ",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose what kind of meeting this will be: instant, scheduled, or recurring."
    },
    "topic": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Topic",
      "description": "The meeting's topic.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide a title for your meeting."
    },
    "agenda": {
      "type": "string",

      "description": "The passcode required to join the meeting. ",
      "human_parameter_description": "The code participants need to enter to join the meeting."

    "timezone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Timezone",
      "description": "The timezone to assign to the `start_time` value. This field is only used for scheduled or recurring meetings with a fixed time. For a list of supported timezones and their formats, see our [timezone list](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/other-references/abbreviation-lists/#timezones).  Omitting this silently falls back to the account's timezone, which may shift meeting times for participants.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify the timezone for the meeting schedule."
    },
    "start_time": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Time",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The meeting's start time. This field is only used for scheduled or recurring meetings with a fixed time. This supports local time and GMT formats.  * To set a meeting's start time in GMT, use the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` date-time format. For example, `2020-03-31T12:02:00Z`.  * To set a meeting's start time using a specific timezone, use the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss` date-time format and specify the [timezone ID](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/other-references/abbreviation-lists/#timezones) in the `timezone` field. If you do not specify a timezone, the `timezone` value defaults to your Zoom account's timezone. You can also use `UTC` for the `timezone` value. **Note:** If no `start_time` is set for a scheduled meeting, the `start_time` is set at the current time and the meeting type changes to an instant meeting, which expires after 30 days. ",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify when the meeting will begin."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",
      "description": "The account admin meeting template ID used to schedule a meeting using a [meeting template](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360036559151-Meeting-templates). For a list of account admin-provided meeting templates, use the [**List meeting templates**](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/methods#operation/listMeetingTemplates) API.  * At this time, this field **only** accepts account admin meeting template IDs.  * To enable the account admin meeting templates feature, [contact Zoom support](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us). ",
```

```json
    "conversation_type": {

      "title": "Conversation Type",

        "external"
      ],
```

## ZOOM_CREATE_IQ_CONVERSATION_COMMENT
DEPRECATED: Use ZOOM_CREATE_ZRA_CONVERSATION_COMMENT instead (Zoom rebranded IQ to ZRA). Tool to create a comment on a Zoom IQ conversation. Use when you need to add comments, replies, or annotations to IQ conversation recordings or transcripts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateIqConversationCommentRequest",
  "required": [
    "conversationId",
    "comment"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "This is a test comment",
        "Great discussion!"
      ],
      "description": "The text content of the comment to add to the conversation."
    },
    "is_private": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Private",
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "Whether the comment is private (visible only to specific users) or public (visible to all conversation participants)."
    },
    "conversationId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Conversation Id",
      "examples": [
        "test123",
        "conv_abc_xyz"
      ],
      "description": "The conversation's unique identifier."
    },
    "mention_team_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Mention Team Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "team789",
          "team101"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of team IDs to mention in the comment. Team members will be notified."
    },
    "mention_user_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Mention User Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "user123",
          "user456"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Array of user IDs to mention in the comment. These users will be notified."
    },
    "parent_comment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Comment Id",
      "examples": [
        "parent_comment_123"
      ],
      "description": "Parent comment ID for threaded replies. Leave empty for top-level comments."
    },
    "time_in_recording": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time In Recording",
      "examples": [
        "00:02:30",
        "01:15:45"
      ],
      "description": "Timestamp in the recording where the comment should be anchored."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateIqConversationComment`"
}
```

## ZOOM_CREATE_PROJECT
Creates a new whiteboard project in Zoom. Use when you need to organize and group whiteboards together, optionally adding collaborators and initializing the project with existing whiteboards.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "owner_email": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owner Email",
      "examples": [
        "owner@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Email address of the project owner. Only usable with admin scope."
    },
    "project_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Name",
      "examples": [
        "My Whiteboard Project",
        "Team Planning Board"
      ],
      "maxLength": 50,
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The name of the whiteboard project. Must be between 1 and 50 characters."
    },
    "collaborators": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Collaborator",
        "required": [
          "email",
          "role"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Role",
            "examples": [
              2,
              3
            ],
            "description": "Role of the collaborator in the project: 1 = Owner, 2 = Editor, 3 = Viewer."
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "examples": [
              "collaborator@example.com"
            ],
            "description": "Email address of the collaborator."
          }
        },
        "description": "Collaborator object for whiteboard project."
      },
      "title": "Collaborators",
      "description": "List of collaborators to add to the project. Each collaborator must have an email and role."
    },
    "invite_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Invite Message",
      "examples": [
        "You have been invited to collaborate on this project."
      ],
      "maxLength": 280,
      "description": "The invite message to send to collaborators. Maximum 280 characters."
    },
    "whiteboard_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Whiteboard Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "wb_abc123",
          "wb_def456"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of whiteboard IDs to add to the project. Whiteboards must belong to the same account."
    },
    "skip_notifications": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Skip Notifications",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "If set to true, collaborators will not receive notifications when added to the project."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateProject`"
}
```

## ZOOM_CREATE_WHITEBOARD
Creates a new whiteboard for the authenticated user. Use when you need to create a blank whiteboard that can be shared and collaborated on with others. The whiteboard will be associated with the user making the API call. **Required scope:** whiteboard:write or whiteboard:write:whiteboard **Notes:** - If no name is provided, the whiteboard will be named "Untitled" - After creation, the whiteboard can be shared with collaborators using share settings

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateWhiteboardRequest",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Team Brainstorm",
        "Project Planning Whiteboard"
      ],
      "description": "The whiteboard name. If not provided, the default name 'Untitled' will be used."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateWhiteboard`."
}
```

## ZOOM_CREATE_WHITEBOARD_EXPORT
Creates an export task to generate PDF exports and audit logs for specified whiteboards. The exported content is bundled into a ZIP file containing the whiteboard PDFs and audit logs. Use when you need to export one or more whiteboards for archival, sharing, or compliance purposes. Use this action when you want to export whiteboard content as a downloadable ZIP file containing PDF exports and audit logs. After creating the export task, poll the GetWhiteboardExportStatus action using the returned task_id until the status changes to 'successed', then download the export using the DownloadWhiteboardExport action. Note: This action only initiates the export process. The export is processed asynchronously. You must poll GetWhiteboardExportStatus to check when the export is ready, then use DownloadWhiteboardExport to retrieve the actual ZIP file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateWhiteboardExportRequest",
  "required": [
    "whiteboard_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "whiteboard_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Whiteboard Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Kpo8i3NMSqab-RIx4yJ7QA"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 50,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The list of whiteboard IDs to export. The list must contain between 1 and 50 unique whiteboard IDs. If more than 50 IDs are provided, only the first 50 will be processed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Whiteboard IDs",
      "human_parameter_description": "A list of whiteboard IDs to include in the export. Maximum 50 whiteboards can be exported at once. Example: ['Kpo8i3NMSqab-RIx4yJ7QA']"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateWhiteboardExport`"
}
```

**Output schema:**

```json
      ],
```

## ZOOM_CREATE_ZRA_CRM_DEALS

## ZOOM_CREATE_ZRA_CRM_SETTINGS
Tool to register a new CRM API integration for Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA). Use when you need to configure CRM settings including type, name, currency, deal stages, and URL patterns for accessing CRM records.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateZraCrmSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "crm_type",
    "deal_stages"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "crm_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Crm Name",
      "description": "Display name for the CRM type. If not provided, defaults to the value of crm_type."
    },
    "crm_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Crm Type",
      "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$",
      "maxLength": 16,
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "CRM type identifier, 1-16 alphanumeric characters, must start with letter (e.g., 'oracle', 'salesforce')."
    },
    "deal_stages": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "DealStage",
        "required": [
          "stage_name",
          "stage_type"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "stage_name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Stage Name",
            "description": "Name of the deal stage (e.g., 'Prospecting', 'Negotiation')."
          },
          "stage_type": {
            "enum": [
              "OPEN",
              "CLOSED_WON",
              "CLOSED_LOST"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Stage Type",
            "description": "Type of the deal stage indicating whether it's open, won, or lost."
          }
        },
        "description": "Individual deal stage object"
      },
      "title": "Deal Stages",
      "minItems": 3,
      "description": "Array of deal stage definitions. Must include at least one stage for each type: OPEN, CLOSED_WON, and CLOSED_LOST."
    },
    "currency_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency Type",
      "description": "Currency unit to use (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). Defaults to 'USD' if not specified."
    },
    "url_pattern_deal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url Pattern Deal",
      "description": "URL pattern template for opening deal objects in the CRM. Use {id} as placeholder for the deal ID (e.g., 'https://example.com/deals/{id}')."
    },
    "url_pattern_lead": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url Pattern Lead",
      "description": "URL pattern template for opening lead objects in the CRM. Use {id} as placeholder (e.g., 'https://example.com/leads/{id}')."
    },
    "url_pattern_account": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url Pattern Account",
      "description": "URL pattern template for opening account objects in the CRM. Use {id} as placeholder (e.g., 'https://example.com/accounts/{id}')."
    },
    "url_pattern_contact": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url Pattern Contact",
      "description": "URL pattern template for opening contact objects in the CRM. Use {id} as placeholder (e.g., 'https://example.com/contacts/{id}')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateZraCrmSettings`"
}
```

## ZOOM_DELETE_A_MEETING
Delete or cancel a scheduled Zoom meeting. Use occurrence_id to delete a specific occurrence of a recurring meeting. Supports notification options for hosts and registrants. Returns HTTP 204 on success. Rate limit: Light. Required scopes: meeting:write or meeting:write:admin.

```json
          "type": "string"
        }
```

## ZOOM_DELETE_PROJECT_COLLABORATOR
Removes a collaborator from a whiteboard project. Use this action when you need to revoke a user's access to a specific whiteboard project. This action is irreversible — once a collaborator is removed, they will no longer have access to the project's whiteboards unless re-added. **Note:** The authenticated user must be the project owner, co-owner, or have admin permissions to remove collaborators.

**Input schema:**
```json

    "project_id",
    "collaborator_id"

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Id",
      "examples": [
        "wTSs0rzGTDG_mdi3RrgFaw",
        "proj_abc123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard project.",
```

## ZOOM_DELETE_WHITEBOARD_COLLABORATOR
Removes a collaborator from a whiteboard. Use this action when you need to revoke a user's access to a specific whiteboard by removing them as a collaborator. This action is irreversible for the collaborator's access — the collaborator will no longer be able to view or edit the whiteboard unless added back. Requires the user to have whiteboard admin or owner permissions. **Prerequisites:** - The authenticated user must be the whiteboard owner, co-owner, or have admin permissions - The collaborator must currently have access to the whiteboard **Common errors:** - "Whiteboard not found" - Invalid whiteboard ID - "Collaborator not found" - The specified collaborator does not have access to the whiteboard - "Insufficient permissions" - User lacks permission to remove collaborators

**Input schema:**

```json
    "collaboratorId"

      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the unique ID of the whiteboard from which you want to remove a collaborator. This ID can be found in the whiteboard details or when listing whiteboards."
    },
    "collaboratorId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Collaborator Id",
      "examples": [
        "test-collaborator-id-123"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the collaborator to remove from the whiteboard. This is the email address or user ID of the collaborator.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the email address or unique ID of the collaborator you want to remove from the whiteboard."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `DeleteWhiteboardCollaborator`"
}
```

## ZOOM_DOWNLOAD_WHITEBOARD_EXPORT
Downloads the exported whiteboard content for a completed whiteboard export task. The task must have completed successfully before calling this action. Use when you need to retrieve the actual whiteboard content (drawings, annotations, images) that was exported using the Create whiteboard export API. Returns a ZIP archive containing the whiteboard files. This action is read-only and does not modify any whiteboard data. Use this action when you have created a whiteboard export task and want to download the resulting ZIP file containing the exported content.

## ZOOM_DOWNLOAD_WHITEBOARD_SESSION_ACTIVITY
Downloads the activity archive file for a whiteboard archiving session. This action retrieves the PDF file containing whiteboard session activity data based on the provided file path. Use when you need to retrieve the archived activity file for a completed whiteboard session. Use this action when you have obtained a file path from the List whiteboard sessions activities endpoint and want to download the actual activity archive file. The file is returned as a PDF stream. This action is read-only and does not modify any data. Note: Files may expire and return 404 if the download URL has expired.

```json
  "type": "object",
```

## ZOOM_GET_A_MEETING
Retrieves detailed information about a Zoom meeting by its ID. Returns comprehensive meeting data including topic, schedule, URLs, passwords, settings, and for recurring meetings, occurrence details and recurrence patterns. For recurring meetings, defaults to the latest occurrence unless occurrence_id or show_previous_occurrences is specified. Returned start_time must be interpreted using the meeting's timezone field. Requires meeting:read scope. Rate limit: LIGHT.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAMeetingRequest",
  "required": [
    "meetingId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "meetingId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Meeting Id",
      "description": "The meeting's ID.   When storing this value in your database, store it as a long format integer and **not** an integer. Meeting IDs can be more than 10 digits.  UUID-style meeting IDs containing a leading '/' or '//' must be double-URL-encoded before use.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the meeting you want to view. Copy it from the Zoom invite or your meeting list; use the full number exactly as shown."
    },
    "occurrence_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Occurrence Id",
      "description": "Meeting occurrence ID. Provide this field to view meeting details of a particular occurrence of the [recurring meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/214973206-Scheduling-Recurring-Meetings). ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Occurrence ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the meeting is recurring, provide the specific occurrence ID to view details for that one instance (date and time) of the series."
    },
    "show_previous_occurrences": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show Previous Occurrences",
      "description": "Set this field's value to `true` to view meeting details of all previous occurrences of a [recurring meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/214973206-Scheduling-Recurring-Meetings).  ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Show Previous Occurrences",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to include details for all past instances of a recurring meeting. Leave it off if you only need the upcoming meeting or a specific occurrence."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetAMeeting`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_A_MEETING_SUMMARY
IMPORTANT: This action requires a PAID Zoom account (Pro, Business, or Enterprise plan). Free Zoom accounts cannot use this feature and will receive a 400 error. Additionally requires: - AI Companion feature enabled in account settings - Meeting must not be end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) - Meeting summary must be enabled and generated for the meeting Rate limit: LIGHT. Response fields such as `summary_details` and `next_steps` are optional and may be absent or empty arrays.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAMeetingSummaryRequest",
  "required": [
    "meetingId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "meetingId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meeting Id",
      "description": "The meeting\u2019s past instance UUID (e.g. \u2018aDYlohsHRtCd4ii1uC2+hA==\u2019). This endpoint only accepts instance UUIDs from list_past_meeting_instances or past_meetings \u2014 the definition UUID from list_meetings will NOT work.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting Instance UUID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The past meeting instance UUID. Get this from list_past_meeting_instances (not list_meetings). The definition UUID from list_meetings will return \u2018Meeting does not exist\u2019."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetAMeetingSummary`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_A_WEBINAR
Access Zoom Webinar details requires Pro or higher plan and Webinar add-on. Scopes include `webinar:read:admin` and `webinar:read`. Granular scopes and a 'LIGHT' rate limit also apply.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAWebinarRequest",
  "required": [
    "webinarId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "webinarId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Webinar Id",
      "description": "The webinar's ID or universally unique ID (UUID).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Webinar ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the webinar you want to retrieve. You can use the numeric Webinar ID or the webinar's UUID from Zoom."
    },
    "occurrence_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Occurrence Id",
      "description": "Unique identifier for an occurrence of a recurring webinar. [Recurring webinars](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216354763-How-to-Schedule-A-Recurring-Webinar) can have a maximum of 50 occurrences. When you create a recurring Webinar using [**Create a webinar**](https://developers.zoom.us) API, you can retrieve the Occurrence ID from the response of the API call. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Occurrence ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the webinar is recurring, provide the specific occurrence ID to get details for that instance. Leave this blank if you don't need a specific occurrence."
    },
    "show_previous_occurrences": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show Previous Occurrences",
      "description": "Set the value of this field to `true` if you would like to view Webinar details of all previous occurrences of a recurring Webinar. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Show Previous Occurrences",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to include details from past occurrences of a recurring webinar. Leave it off to see only the current or upcoming occurrence."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetAWebinar`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_MARKETPLACE_USER_ENTITLEMENTS
Retrieves marketplace entitlements for a specific Zoom user by ID or 'me'. Returns list of entitlements associated with the user's account. Use when you need to check user marketplace subscriptions or permissions.

## ZOOM_GET_MEETING_RECORDINGS
To download meeting recordings, use `download_url`. Include OAuth token in the header for passcode-protected ones. Supports `recording:read` and `phone_recording:read:admin` scopes, with a `LIGHT` rate limit. Requires a paid Zoom plan with cloud recording enabled; missing entitlements return empty results or entitlement errors, not system failures. Error code 3301 means no cloud recording exists for the meeting — an expected empty-result case.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetMeetingRecordingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "meetingId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ttl": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Ttl",
      "description": "The `download_access_token` Time to Live (TTL) value. This parameter is only valid if the `include_fields` query parameter contains the `download_access_token` value. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "TTL",
      "human_parameter_description": "How long the download access token should stay valid, in seconds. Only set this when you've included 'download_access_token' above."
    },
    "meetingId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meeting Id",
      "description": "To get a meeting's cloud recordings, provide the meeting ID or UUID. If providing the meeting ID instead of UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance. To get a webinar's cloud recordings, provide the webinar's ID or UUID. If providing the webinar ID instead of UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The meeting or webinar ID/UUID whose cloud recordings you want to retrieve. If you use a regular meeting ID instead of a UUID, we'll return the latest occurrence."
    },
    "include_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Include Fields",
      "description": "Set to 'download_access_token' to include a JWT token for downloading the meeting's recordings. This token can be appended to download URLs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Fields",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional extras to include with the results. Set to 'download_access_token' if you plan to download the recording files directly."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetMeetingRecordings`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_PAST_MEETING_PARTICIPANTS
Retrieves the list of participants who attended a past (ended) Zoom meeting. Requires a paid Zoom account (Pro or higher). Meeting must have ended with at least one participant (excluding solo meetings). Use meeting ID for the latest instance, or instance UUID for a specific occurrence.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetPastMeetingParticipantsRequest",
  "required": [
    "meetingId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "meetingId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meeting Id",
      "description": "The meeting's numeric ID or instance UUID. If you provide a numeric meeting ID, the API returns participants for the latest meeting instance. If you provide a UUID, it must be an *instance* UUID (from list_past_meeting_instances), not the series UUID from list_meetings.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The numeric meeting ID or instance UUID. For recurring meetings, use list_past_meeting_instances to get the instance UUID for a specific occurrence. The series UUID from list_meetings will not work."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 30,
      "description": "The number of records returned within a single API call.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many participants to return in one page of results. Larger numbers show more at once; smaller numbers make pages load faster."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "Use the next page token to paginate through large result sets. A next page token is returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. This token's expiration period is 15 minutes.  Exhaust all pages by repeatedly calling with the returned token until it is absent; stopping early silently omits remaining participants.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Next Page Token",
      "human_parameter_description": "Use the token from a previous call to get the next page of participants. Leave this blank to start with the first page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetPastMeetingParticipants`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_USER

The following login methods are only available in China: `11` - Phone number, `21` - WeChat, `23` - Alipay.",

## ZOOM_GET_WHITEBOARD
Retrieves details about a specific whiteboard document. Returns comprehensive whiteboard information including name, creation/modification dates, share settings, and classification. Use this action when you need to fetch metadata for a specific whiteboard by its ID. Requires whiteboard:read or whiteboard:read:admin scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetWhiteboardRequest",
  "required": [
    "whiteboardId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "whiteboardId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Whiteboard Id",
      "examples": [
        "Kpo8i3NMSqab-RIx4yJ7QA"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Whiteboard ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard you want to retrieve. Example: Kpo8i3NMSqab-RIx4yJ7QA"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetWhiteboard`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_WHITEBOARD_EXPORT_STATUS
Retrieves the status of a whiteboard export task by its task ID. This action queries the current state of an export request initiated via the create whiteboard export action. Use this action when you need to check whether a whiteboard export has completed processing, is still being generated, or has failed. Poll this endpoint until status changes from 'processing' to either 'successed' or 'failed'. The export is processed asynchronously, so you should poll this endpoint periodically to check for completion before attempting to download the exported file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetWhiteboardExportStatusRequest",
  "required": [
    "task_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "task_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task Id",
      "examples": [
        "adcc655d3a3549e692959737fe2a7a0d"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard export task. This ID is returned when you create a whiteboard export. Example: adcc655d3a3549e692959737fe2a7a0d",
      "human_parameter_name": "Task ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard export task to check status for. This ID is returned from the create whiteboard export action."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `GetWhiteboardExportStatus`"
}
```

## ZOOM_GET_WHITEBOARD_SESSION
Retrieves detailed information about a specific whiteboard session by its session ID. Returns session metadata including start/end times, whiteboard info, and a list of activities performed during the session. Use this action when you need to retrieve session details, activity logs, or participant information for a Zoom Whiteboard session. For large result sets, use pagination with next_page_token.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetWhiteboardSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "sessionId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "maximum": 300,
      "minimum": 1,

      "description": "The session unique ID. You can get this ID from the session list API or from webhook payloads when sessions are created or updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Session ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the whiteboard session you want to retrieve."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "The next page token is used to paginate through a large set of results. Provided in the response when there are more records available.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Next Page Token",

}
```

## ZOOM_IMPORT_WHITEBOARD
Initiates an import of a whiteboard from an external source (Miro, Mural, or Visio files). The import is processed asynchronously and returns a task_id for tracking progress. Use this task_id to poll for import completion and retrieve the resulting whiteboard. Use this action when you need to convert an externally created whiteboard into a Zoom whiteboard. The file must already be uploaded to Zoom before initiating the import.

**Input schema:**
```json

    },
```

## ZOOM_LIST_ALL_RECORDINGS
This text details how to list Zoom cloud recordings for a user, notably by using "me" for user-level apps and requiring an OAuth token for access. It requires a Pro plan, Cloud Recording enabled, and has a MEDIUM rate limit.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListAllRecordingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "userId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mc": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mc",
      "default": "false",
      "description": "The query metadata of the recording if using an on-premise meeting connector for the meeting. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Metadata Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to 'true' to include metadata from an on\u2011premise meeting connector; otherwise leave as 'false'. Most users can ignore this."
    },
    "to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To",
      "description": "The end date in \"yyyy-mm-dd\" UTC format. Maximum date range from start is 1 month. If no value is provided, defaults to the day after the 'from' date.",
      "human_parameter_name": "End Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "The latest date to include (UTC, yyyy-mm-dd). Must be within 1 month of start date."
    },
    "from": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From",
      "description": "The start date in \"yyyy-mm-dd\" UTC format. Maximum date range is 1 month - if a larger range is requested, the API will adjust the 'from' date to be 1 month before the 'to' date. If no value is provided, defaults to current date. Note: trash files cannot be filtered by date range.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Start Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "The earliest date to include (UTC, yyyy-mm-dd). Maximum range is 1 month from the end date."
    },
    "trash": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Trash",
      "default": false,
      "description": "The query trash. * `true` - List recordings from trash.   * `false` - Do not list recordings from the trash.   The default value is `false`. If you set it to `true`, you can use the `trash_type` property to indicate the type of Cloud recording that you need to retrieve.  ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Trash",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to include recordings that are in the trash. Turn this on if you\u2019re looking for deleted recordings."
    },
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "description": "The user's ID or email address. For user-level apps, pass the `me` value. Using another user's ID instead of `me` requires admin-level permissions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or ID of the user whose recordings you want to view. Use 'me' to access your own recordings."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 30,
      "description": "The number of records returned within a single API call.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many recordings to return per page. Larger numbers show more results at once; smaller numbers load faster."
    },
    "meeting_id": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Meeting Id",
      "description": "The meeting ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide a specific meeting ID to only return recordings from that meeting. Leave blank to see recordings from all meetings."
    },
    "trash_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Trash Type",
      "default": "meeting_recordings",
      "description": "The type of cloud recording to retrieve from the trash.     *   `meeting_recordings`: List all meeting recordings from the trash.    *  `recording_file`: List all individual recording files from the trash.  ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Trash Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "When including trash, choose whether to list whole meeting recordings or individual recording files. Use 'meeting_recordings' for full meetings or 'recording_file' for individual files."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "The next page token paginates through a large set of results. A next page token returns whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes. Loop calls until `next_page_token` is empty to retrieve all records; results are silently truncated at `page_size` per call.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Next Page Token",

    }

  "description": "Request schema for `ListAllRecordings`"
}
```

## ZOOM_LIST_ARCHIVED_FILES
Lists archived meeting and webinar files within a specified date range (max 7 days). Requires the 'Meeting and Webinar Archiving' feature to be enabled by Zoom Support. Use this to retrieve compliance recordings archived to third-party storage platforms.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListArchivedFilesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To",
      "description": "The query end date, in `yyyy-MM-dd\"T\"HH:mm:ssZ` format. This value and the `from` query parameter value cannot exceed seven days. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "End Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "The latest date and time to include when listing archived files. Set this to the end of the time window you want to review."
    },
    "from": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From",
      "description": "The query start date, in `yyyy-MM-dd\"T\"HH:mm:ssZ` format. This value and the `to` query parameter value cannot exceed seven days. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Start Date",
      "human_parameter_description": "The earliest date and time to include when listing archived files. Set this to the start of the time window you want to review."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "description": "The group ID. To get a group ID, use the [List groups](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/reference/scim-api/methods/#operation/groupSCIM2List) API. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Group ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Limit the results to archived files for a specific Zoom group. Provide the ID of the group you want to filter by."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 30,
      "description": "The number of records returned within a single API call.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many archived files to return per page. Increase this to see more results at once, or lower it for shorter pages."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "Use the next page token to paginate through large result sets. A next page token is returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. This token's expiration period is 15 minutes. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Next Page Token",
      "human_parameter_description": "The token from the previous results page to continue where you left off. Use this when there are more results than fit on one page."
    },
    "query_date_type": {
      "enum": [
        "meeting_start_time",
        "archive_complete_time"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "QueryDateTypeEnm",
      "default": "meeting_start_time",
      "description": "The type of query date. * `meeting_start_time`  * `archive_complete_time`   This value defaults to `meeting_start_time`. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Query Date Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether your date range should be based on when the meeting started or when archiving finished. Pick the option that best matches how you want to filter results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListArchivedFiles`"
}
```

## ZOOM_LIST_DEVICES
Lists devices in your Zoom account managed through Zoom Device Management (ZDM). Returns information about Zoom Room devices including computers, controllers, scheduling displays, and whiteboards. **Scopes:** `device:read:admin`, `device:write:admin`, `device:read:list_zdm_devices:admin` **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `HEAVY`

## ZOOM_LIST_MEETINGS
This Zoom API lists a user's scheduled meetings using the `me` value for user-level apps, excluding instant meetings and only showing unexpired ones. Requires specific scopes and has a `MEDIUM` rate limit. No server-side filtering by topic, agenda, or text fields; all such filtering must be done client-side. `meetingId` values exceed 32-bit integer range; treat as full-length numeric or string identifiers.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListMeetingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "userId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To",
      "description": "The end date.",

    },

      "human_parameter_description": "The earliest meeting date to include in your results. Set this to limit the list to a specific date range."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "scheduled",
        "live",
        "upcoming",
        "upcoming_meetings",
        "previous_meetings"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "scheduled",
      "description": "The type of meeting.  * `scheduled` - All valid previous (unexpired) meetings, live meetings, and upcoming scheduled meetings.  * `live` - All the ongoing meetings.  * `upcoming` - All upcoming meetings, including live meetings.  * `upcoming_meetings` - All upcoming meetings, including live meetings.  * `previous_meetings` - All the previous meetings. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which kinds of meetings to list (scheduled, live, upcoming, or previous). Use this to narrow the results to what you need."
    },
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "description": "The user's user ID or email address. For user-level apps, pass the `me` value. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or Zoom user ID of the person whose meetings you want to list. Use 'me' to view your own meetings."
    },
    "timezone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Timezone",
      "description": "The timezone to assign to the `from` and `to` value. For a list of supported timezones and their formats, see our [timezone list](https://developers.zoom.us/docs/api/rest/other-references/abbreviation-lists/#timezones). ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Timezone",

      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "Use the next page token to paginate through large result sets. A next page token is returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. This token's expiration period is 15 minutes. Iterate until `next_page_token` is empty/null to avoid missing meetings. ## ZOOM_LIST_USERS_COLLABORATION_DEVICES
```
Tool to list collaboration devices associated with a user. Use when you need to retrieve information about a user's collaboration devices. For user-level apps, pass 'me' instead of the userId parameter to get devices for the authenticated user.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListUsersCollaborationDevicesRequest",
  "required": [
```

## ZOOM_LIST_USERS_SETTINGS
Tool to retrieve a user's settings including meeting scheduling, in-meeting features, email notifications, recording, telephony, and security preferences. Use when you need to check or display a user's Zoom configuration settings.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListUsersSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "userId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "option": {
      "enum": [
        "meeting_authentication",
        "recording_authentication",
        "security",
        "meeting_security",
        "schedule_meeting",
        "in_meeting",
        "email_notification",
        "recording",
        "telephony",
        "feature",
        "tsp",
        "profile",
        "audio_conferencing"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OptionEnum",
      "description": "Options for filtering the response fields"
    },
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "abc123"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass the 'me' value to fetch the authenticated user's settings."
    },
    "login_type": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Login Type",
      "description": "The user's login method. Use this parameter to filter settings for users with a specific login type: `0` - Facebook OAuth, `1` - Google OAuth, `24` - Apple OAuth, `27` - Microsoft OAuth, `97` - Mobile device, `98` - RingCentral OAuth, `99` - API user, `100` - Zoom Work email, `101` - Single Sign-On (SSO)."
    },
    "custom_query_fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom Query Fields",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of custom field names to include in the response. Use this to request specific custom attributes for the user."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListUsersSettings`"
}
```

## ZOOM_LIST_WEBINAR_PARTICIPANTS

**Input schema:**

```json
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "Use the next page token to paginate through large result sets. A next page token is returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. This token's expiration period is 15 minutes. ",

}
```

## ZOOM_LIST_WEBINAR_REGISTRANTS
Retrieves the list of registrants for a webinar with registration enabled. This endpoint returns registrants (people who registered for the webinar), not participants (people who attended). Use this action when you need to view registrant details for CRM sync, reporting, or managing approvals for registration-based webinars. Supports filtering by occurrence, status (approved/pending/denied), and tracking source for targeted queries.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListWebinarRegistrantsRequest",
  "required": [
    "webinarId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "approved",
        "pending",
        "denied"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "RegistrantStatus",
      "examples": [
        "approved"
      ],
      "description": "Status filter for webinar registrants"
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 25,
      "maximum": 300,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        25
      ],
      "description": "The number of records returned within a single API call. Maximum is 300."
    },
    "webinarId": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Webinar Id",
      "examples": [
        "99887766554"
      ],
      "description": "The webinar's ID or universally unique ID (UUID). When storing this value in your database, store it as a long format integer."
    },
    "occurrence_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Occurrence Id",
      "examples": [
        "1648194360000"
      ],
      "description": "The webinar occurrence ID for which to list registrants. Use this to filter registrants for a specific occurrence of a recurring webinar."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "examples": [
        "IAfJX3jsOLW7w3dokmFl84zOa0MAVGyMEB2"
      ],
      "description": "Use the next page token to paginate through large result sets. A next page token is returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. This token's expiration period is 15 minutes."
    },
    "tracking_source_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tracking Source Id",
      "examples": [
        "track_12345"
      ],
      "description": "Filter registrants by tracking source ID. Use this to get registrants attributed to a specific campaign or source."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListWebinarRegistrants`"
}
```

## ZOOM_LIST_WEBINARS
The API lists all scheduled webinars for Zoom users with a webinar plan, using `me` for user-level apps. It only shows unexpired webinars for hosts broadcasting to up to 10,000 attendees. Requires Pro plan upwards and specific scopes. Rate limit: MEDIUM.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListWebinarsRequest",
  "required": [
    "userId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "scheduled",
        "upcoming"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "scheduled",
      "description": "The type of webinar.  * `scheduled` - All valid previous (unexpired) webinars, live webinars, and upcoming scheduled webinars.  * `upcoming` - All upcoming webinars, including live webinars. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Webinar Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which webinars to show\u2014either scheduled (including past unexpired, live, and upcoming) or only upcoming and live. This helps you focus on the timeframe you care about."
    },
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "description": "The user's user ID or email address. For user-level apps, pass the `me` value. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or ID of the Zoom user whose webinars you want to list. Use 'me' to list your own webinars."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 30,
      "description": "The number of records returned within a single API call.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many webinars to return per page. Increase this to see more results at once, or lower it for smaller pages."
    },
    "page_number": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Number",
      "description": "**Deprecated** We will no longer support this field in a future release. Instead, use the `next_page_token` for pagination. ",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Number",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which page of results you want to view, starting at 1. This option is being phased out\u2014use next_page_token when available."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "Token for fetching the next page of results. Received from the previous response's next_page_token field.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Next Page Token",
      "human_parameter_description": "Use this token to fetch the next page of results. Get it from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListWebinars`"
}
```

## ZOOM_LIST_ZRA_CONVERSATIONS
Tool to list all conversations in Zoom Revenue Accelerator. Use when you need to retrieve analytics data from Revenue Accelerator conversations, including engagement scores, sentiment analysis, and meeting metrics.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListZraConversationsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "to": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z"
      ],
      "description": "End date for filtering conversations in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Use with 'from' parameter to define a date range."
    },
    "from": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From",
      "examples": [
        "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "Start date for filtering conversations in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Use with 'to' parameter to define a date range."
    },
    "deal_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Deal Id",
      "examples": [
        "deal101"
      ],
      "description": "Filter conversations by deal ID. Use this to see conversations linked to a specific deal."
    },
    "host_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Host Id",
      "examples": [
        "abc123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "Filter conversations by host ID. Use this to see only conversations hosted by a specific user."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "team789"
      ],
      "description": "Filter conversations by team ID. Use this to see conversations associated with a specific team."
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Page Size",
      "default": 30,
      "maximum": 300,
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "Number of records to return per page. Maximum 300."
    },
    "period_type": {
      "enum": [
        "meetingStartTime",
        "iqProcessedTime"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PeriodType",
      "description": "Period type for filtering conversations"
    },
    "participant_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Participant Id",
      "examples": [
        "def456uvw"
      ],
      "description": "Filter conversations by participant ID. Use this to find conversations involving a specific participant."
    },
    "next_page_token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Next Page Token",
      "description": "Token for fetching the next page of results. Obtained from the previous response's next_page_token field. This token expires in 15 minutes."
    },
    "conversation_type": {
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "meeting",
        "phone"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ConversationType",
      "description": "Conversation type filter"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListZraConversations`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
```

## ZOOM_MOVE_WHITEBOARDS_TO_PROJECT
Moves one or more whiteboards to a specified Zoom Whiteboard project. Use when you need to organize whiteboards by assigning them to a specific project for better management and access control. The maximum number of whiteboards that can be moved in a single request is 50.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MoveWhiteboardsToProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "projectId",
    "whiteboard_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "projectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Id",
      "examples": [
        "wTSs0rzGTDG_mdi3RrgFaw",
        "abc123xyz"
      ],
      "description": "The Project ID. This is a path parameter identifying the target project."
    },
    "whiteboard_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Whiteboard Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "DKn6tfWeTV6yz5uQZWWHcg"
        ],
        [
          "whiteboard_1",
          "whiteboard_2",
          "whiteboard_3"
        ]
      ],
      "max_items": 50,
      "description": "List of whiteboard IDs to move to the specified project. Maximum 50 whiteboards per request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `MoveWhiteboardsToProject`"
}
```

**Output schema:**

## ZOOM_REMOVE_WHITEBOARD_CLASSIFICATION
Removes the classification label from a whiteboard. Use this action when you need to unassign or clear a security classification label from an existing whiteboard. Not supported in Gov cluster. Each whiteboard can only have one classification label at a time — calling this action removes the currently applied classification, if any. This action is reversible — you can apply a new classification label afterward using the ApplyClassificationToWhiteboard action.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveWhiteboardClassificationRequest",
  "required": [
    "whiteboardId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "whiteboardId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Whiteboard Id",
      "examples": [
        "1OT3G20JT_uV8XhMunZ5Fg"
      ],
      "description": "The whiteboard's unique identifier."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `RemoveWhiteboardClassification`"
}
```

```json
  "type": "object",

        "code": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Code",
          "description": "Error code returned in error responses (e.g., 400 for invalid field, 403 for insufficient permissions, 404 for not found)."
        },
        "message": {

          "title": "Message",
```

## ZOOM_REMOVE_WHITEBOARDS_FROM_PROJECT
Removes one or more whiteboards from a specified Zoom Whiteboard project. This action is irreversible — once whiteboards are removed from a project, they cannot be automatically restored to that project. Use when you need to clean up whiteboards from a project or reassign them to a different project.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveWhiteboardsFromProjectRequest",
  "required": [
    "project_id",
    "whiteboard_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "project_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Project Id",
      "examples": [
        "wTSs0rzGTDG_mdi3RrgFaw"
      ],
      "description": "The project ID from which to remove the whiteboards."
    },
    "whiteboard_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Whiteboard Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "1OT3G20JT_uV8XhMunZ5Fg",
          "2OT3G20JT_uV8XhMunZ5Fg"
        ]
      ],
      "maxItems": 50,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The list of whiteboard IDs to remove from the project. Maximum of 50 IDs allowed."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `RemoveWhiteboardsFromProject`"
}
```


## ZOOM_UPDATE_A_MEETING
To update a meeting via API, ensure `start_time` is future-dated; `recurrence` is needed. Limit: 100 requests/day, 100 updates/meeting in 24 hrs. Requires `meeting:write` and `meeting:write:admin` scopes, with a `LIGHT` rate limit.

## ZOOM_UPDATE_CLASSIFICATION_LABEL
Updates an existing classification label in Zoom Whiteboard. Use this action when you need to modify the name, color, sensitivity level, description, guideline URL, or default status of an existing classification label. Only the fields provided in the request body will be updated. Changes are saved as a draft and may need to be published separately. Use this action when you need to rename a classification label to better reflect its purpose, update the color coding for visibility, adjust sensitivity levels to match your organization's security policies, or change which label is set as the default for new whiteboards. Note: This action modifies existing data but is not destructive — the classification label and all associated whiteboards remain intact even after updates.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateClassificationLabelRequest",
  "required": [
    "classificationId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Confidential",
        "Internal"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the classification label. The name must be between 1 and 30 characters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the new display name for the classification label (1-30 characters)."
    },
    "color": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color",
      "pattern": "^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$",
      "examples": [
        "#FF5733",
        "#3A7BD5"
      ],
      "description": "The hex color code for the label. Must be in the format: # followed by 6 hexadecimal characters (e.g., #FF5733).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Color",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter a hex color code for the label (e.g., #FF5733)."
    },
    "is_default": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Default",
      "description": "Whether this label should be automatically applied to new whiteboards. Only one label can be the default. If setting this to true, ensure no other label is currently set as default.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Default",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether this label should be the default for new whiteboards."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Label for confidential documents",
        "Internal use only"
      ],
      "maxLength": 1000,
      "description": "A description of what this classification label represents. The description can have a maximum of 1000 characters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide a description of what this classification label represents (max 1000 characters)."
    },
    "guideline_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Guideline Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://example.com/classification-guidelines"
      ],
      "maxLength": 512,
      "description": "An HTTPS URL linking to classification guidelines or policies. The URL must be a valid HTTPS URL with a maximum of 512 characters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Guideline URL",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide an HTTPS URL linking to classification guidelines or policies (max 512 characters)."
    },
    "classificationId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Classification Id",
      "examples": [
        "test-classification-id",
        "label_abc123"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the classification label to update. This ID is returned when you create or list classification labels.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Classification ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the unique ID of the classification label you want to update. You can find this ID in the Zoom whiteboard settings or when listing classification labels."
    },
    "sensitivity_level": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Sensitivity Level",
      "maximum": 5,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        3,
        5
      ],
      "description": "The sensitivity rank of the label. This value must be between 1 and 5, where higher values indicate higher sensitivity.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Sensitivity Level",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the sensitivity level from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateClassificationLabel`"
}
```

## ZOOM_UPDATE_PROJECT
Updates the name of an existing whiteboard project in Zoom. This action allows you to rename a project to better reflect its content or purpose. The project_id is required to identify which project to update. This action is commonly used when reorganizing whiteboard content or updating project names to reflect new themes. Use this action when you need to rename a whiteboard project to better organize your Zoom whiteboards, update project names to reflect new topics or purposes, or batch-rename projects as part of a larger content management workflow. Note: This action modifies existing data but is not destructive — the project and all its associated whiteboards remain intact even after a name change.

## ZOOM_UPDATE_PROJECT_COLLABORATORS
Updates collaborator permissions for a whiteboard project. Use this action when you need to change the permission level of one or more collaborators on a whiteboard project. This allows reassigning roles such as changing a viewer to an editor or promoting a collaborator to owner status. **Prerequisites:** - The user must be the project owner or have admin permissions - The whiteboard project must exist and be accessible **Required fields:** project_id, collaborators (list with collaborator_id and role for each) **Common errors:** - "User not found" - The collaborator ID does not match a Zoom user - "Project not found" - Invalid project ID - "Invalid collaborator role" - Role value must be 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4

## ZOOM_UPDATE_WHITEBOARD_COLLABORATOR
Updates collaborator settings for a whiteboard. Changes the permission role for one or more collaborators on the whiteboard. Use this action when you need to modify what access levels collaborators have, such as promoting a viewer to editor or demoting an owner to co-owner. Note: When assigning a new Owner or Co-owner, the user must belong to the same account as the original Owner. If ownership is transferred, the original owner automatically becomes a Co-owner. This action is irreversible once the role changes are saved.

**Input schema:**

```json
        "required": [
          "collaborator_id",

        ],

            "enum": [
              "owner",
              "co_owner",
              "editor",
              "commenter",
              "viewer"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Role",
            "description": "The role/permission level for the collaborator. 0=Owner (full control), 1=Co-owner, 2=Editor (can edit), 3=Commenter (can comment), 4=Viewer (view only). Note: When assigning a new Owner or Co-owner, the user must belong to the same account as the original Owner.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator Role",
            "human_parameter_description": "Choose the permission level for this collaborator: Owner, Co-owner, Editor, Commenter, or Viewer."

          "collaborator_id": {

              "john.doe@example.com"

            "description": "The unique identifier of the collaborator (user ID or email). This user must exist in the Zoom account.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Collaborator ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The user ID or email address of the collaborator whose role you want to update."
          }
        },
        "description": "A collaborator to update on the whiteboard."
      },
      "title": "Collaborators",
      "maxItems": 100,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of collaborators to update. Each collaborator must have a collaborator_id and a role. Minimum 1 collaborator, maximum 100 collaborators per request.",
```
