## ZOOM_UPLOAD_WHITEBOARD_FILE
Uploads a file to be used in Zoom Whiteboard. Supports PDF and Visio (.vsdx) file formats. Use when you need to import external documents into Zoom Whiteboard for collaboration and editing. The file upload uses a separate file API endpoint (fileapi.zoom.us).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadWhiteboardFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "examples": [
        "whiteboard_content.pdf",
        "diagram.vsdx"
      ],
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "The file to upload to the whiteboard. Supported formats: .pdf, .vsdx (Visio). FileUploadable object where 'name' is the filename (e.g., 'document.pdf', 'diagram.vsdx'), 'mimetype' is the MIME type (e.g., 'application/pdf'), and 's3key' is the path to a previously staged Composio file. Alternatively, provide 'source' as a local file path and the action will derive mimetype automatically.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UploadWhiteboardFile`"
}
```

## ZOOM_VALIDATE_MARKETPLACE_APP_MANIFEST
Tool to validate a Zoom Marketplace app manifest before submission or update. Use when you need to verify that an app manifest configuration is valid and meets Zoom's requirements.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ValidateMarketplaceAppManifestRequest",
  "required": [
    "manifest"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "app_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "App Id",
      "description": "Optional app ID to validate the manifest against an existing marketplace app. If provided, validates compatibility with the specified app."
    },
    "manifest": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Manifest",
      "required": [
        "display_information",
        "oauth_information",
        "features"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "features": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Features",
          "required": [
            "products",
            "development_home_uri",
            "production_home_uri"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "products": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Products",
              "description": "Array of Zoom products the app supports. Common values: 'ZOOM_MEETING', 'ZOOM_WEBINAR', 'ZOOM_PHONE', 'ZOOM_CHAT'."
            },
            "production_home_uri": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Production Home Uri",
              "description": "Home page URI for the app in production environment (e.g., 'https://example.com')."
            },
            "development_home_uri": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Development Home Uri",
              "description": "Home page URI for the app in development environment (e.g., 'https://localhost:3000')."
            }
          },
          "description": "Features section defining supported products and home URIs.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "oauth_information": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Oauth Information",
          "required": [
            "usage",
            "development_redirect_uri",
            "production_redirect_uri",
            "scopes"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "usage": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Usage",
              "description": "OAuth usage type for the app. Common values: 'USER_OPERATION' for user-level apps, 'ACCOUNT_OPERATION' for account-level apps."
            },
            "scopes": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "title": "ScopeInfo",
                "required": [
                  "scope",
                  "optional"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "scope": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Scope",
                    "description": "The OAuth scope identifier (e.g., 'user:read:email', 'meeting:write')."
                  },
                  "optional": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "title": "Optional",
                    "description": "Whether this scope is optional for the app functionality. Set false for required scopes."
                  }
                },
                "description": "OAuth scope configuration for the marketplace app"
              },
              "title": "Scopes",
              "description": "Array of OAuth scopes required by the app. Each scope must specify the scope identifier and whether it's optional."
            },
            "production_redirect_uri": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Production Redirect Uri",
              "description": "OAuth redirect URI for production environment (e.g., 'https://example.com/callback')."
            },
            "development_redirect_uri": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Development Redirect Uri",
              "description": "OAuth redirect URI for development environment (e.g., 'https://localhost:3000/callback')."
            }
          },
          "description": "OAuth configuration section with redirect URIs and scopes.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "display_information": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Display Information",
          "required": [
            "description",
            "display_name",
            "long_description"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "description": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Description",
              "description": "Short description of the app (max 250 characters). This appears in the marketplace listing."
            },
            "display_name": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Display Name",
              "description": "Display name of the app as shown to users in the marketplace."
            },
            "long_description": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Long Description",
              "description": "Detailed description of the app, its features, and functionality."
            }
          },
          "description": "Display information section with app name and descriptions.",
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "description": "The complete app manifest object to validate. Must include display_information, oauth_information, and features sections.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ValidateMarketplaceAppManifest`"
}
```
